steps.instruction: Boil penne pasta in rolling salted water for 9 mins until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Prepare Garlic Cream Sauce
steps.instruction: Melt butter in a pan, sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds until aromatic. Pour in Amul cream and sweet corn kernels, simmering on low heat for 2 mins.

steps.title: Toss & Coat Penne
steps.instruction: Add boiled penne to the cream sauce with 2 tbsp reserved pasta water. Stir in cheese and Italian herbs until every pasta tube is coated in luxurious silk.

chefTip: Always save a splash of starchy pasta water — it binds the cream and cheese sauce so it never separates.
kitIncludes: Disano Durum Wheat Semolina Penne Pasta
Mother Dairy Full Cream Fresh Milk
Amul Diced Mozzarella & Cheddar Pizza Cheese
Keya Italian Pizza Seasoning & Chilli Flakes

name: Fiery Red Sauce Arrabiata Fusilli Pasta
headline: Spiral fusilli pasta tossed in tangy Italian plum tomato marinara, garlic, crushed red chili flakes & basil
description: Authentic trattoria spicy red sauce pasta made with spiral durum wheat fusilli that locks in the tangy slow-cooked tomato marinara, infused with garlic, spicy chili flakes, extra virgin olive oil and fresh cheese.

ingredients.name: Mandi Fresh Red Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: 2 large ripe tomatoes pureed for fresh arrabiata

ingredients.name: Ching's Secret Schezwan Chutney & Dip
ingredients.notes: 1.5 tbsp for tangy spicy desi arrabiata punch

ingredients.name: Keya Italian Pizza Seasoning & Chilli Flakes
ingredients.notes: Oregano, chilli flakes and pasta mix

steps.title: Boil Spiral Fusilli
steps.instruction: Cook fusilli in salted boiling water for 8 mins until tender with a bite. Drain.

steps.title: Simmer Arrabiata Marinara
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil/butter, sauté garlic slices and chili flakes for 30 seconds. Stir in Veeba pasta sauce and sweet corn, simmering for 3 mins until rich and fragrant.

steps.title: Combine & Garnish
steps.instruction: Toss the drained fusilli directly into the bubbling tomato sauce. Cook for 1 minute on high heat so spirals absorb the tangy sauce. Top with cheese and serve piping hot.

chefTip: Fusilli spirals are the best shape for Arrabiata because the grooves catch and hold maximum marinara sauce in every forkful.
kitIncludes: Keya Italian Pizza Seasoning & Chilli Flakes

name: Artisan Cheesy Veg Thin-Crust Pan Pizza
headline: Crispy 8-inch thin crust pizza topped with herb marinara sauce, loaded mozzarella cheese, capsicum & sweet corn
description: Freshly baked pizzeria style pan pizza you can make on a standard tawa or oven in 10 minutes: crispy artisan thin crust, tangy Italian herb marinara, loaded molten mozzarella and crunchy farm veggies.

ingredients.name: English Oven 8-inch Thin Crust Pizza Base (2 pcs)
ingredients.notes: 2 thin crust pizza bases (or wheat flour dough)

ingredients.name: Veeba Pizza & Pasta Sauce
ingredients.notes: 2 tbsp rich tomato herb pizza spread

ingredients.name: Amul Diced Mozzarella & Cheddar Pizza Cheese
Keya Italian Pizza Seasoning & Chilli Flakes

steps.title: Sauce the Pizza Crust
steps.instruction: Place the pizza base on a flat surface. Spread 2 generous spoonfuls of Veeba Pizza Sauce in circular motion leaving 1/2 inch rim.

steps.title: Toppings & Cheese Blanket
steps.instruction: Scatter diced capsicum, onions and sweet corn across the base. Cover generously with Amul mozzarella & cheddar cheese blend.

steps.title: Pan Bake or Oven Melt
steps.instruction: Place pizza on a buttered heavy pan, cover with a tight lid and cook on low heat for 7-8 mins until base is crispy and cheese is bubbling and molten. Sprinkle oregano and slice!

chefTip: Cooking on low heat with a tight lid on a heavy tawa produces the exact same bubbly cheese and crunchy crust as a 300°C brick oven!
kitIncludes: English Oven 8-inch Thin Crust Pizza Base (2 pcs)
Amul Diced Mozzarella & Cheddar Pizza Cheese
Keya Italian Pizza Seasoning & Chilli Flakes

name: Kolkata Tandoori Paneer Kathi Roll
headline: Flaky pan-toasted Malabar paratha wrapped around juicy spiced paneer cubes, pickled onions, chaat masala & mint chutney
description: Iconic Kolkata Park Street style street roll with crispy multi-layered flaky paratha rolled around smoky marinated paneer cubes, crunchy lemon onions, fresh green chilies and chatpata mint chutney.

ingredients.name: ID Fresh Malabar Parota (Pack of 5)
ingredients.notes: 2 flaky golden parathas / kathi roll wraps

steps.title: Sear Spiced Paneer Batons
steps.instruction: Toss paneer fingers and capsicum with tandoori spices and chaat masala. Sauté in hot pan with 1 tsp ghee for 3 mins until edges are golden.

steps.title: Toast Flaky Malabar Paratha
steps.instruction: Cook the layered paratha on a hot tawa with a drizzle of desi ghee for 90 seconds per side until crispy golden and flaky.

steps.title: Roll & Wrap Kolkata Style
steps.instruction: Place paratha flat. Arrange paneer batons in a line, add lemon pickled onions, a sprinkle of chaat masala and mint chutney. Roll up tightly into parchment paper and bite in!

chefTip: Toss raw onion rings with lemon juice and a pinch of salt 5 minutes before rolling — it cuts the sharpness and gives that signature street crunch.

name: Kolkata Double Egg Chicken Bhuna Roll
headline: Flaky paratha coated with two farm eggs, filled with tender bhuna chicken chunks, green chilies and lemon juice
description: The undisputed king of Kolkata street food: layered flaky paratha fried with two beaten farm eggs on the tawa, packed with spicy bhuna chicken chunks, onion rings, green chilies and a squeeze of fresh lime.

ingredients.name: Fresh Tender Boneless Chicken Breast Fillet
Farm Fresh White Eggs
ingredients.notes: 4 eggs (2 eggs per paratha for authentic double-egg roll)

ingredients.name: Cooking Oil / Ghee
ingredients.notes: 2 tbsp for chicken and egg-paratha shallow fry

steps.title: Sauté Bhuna Chicken Chunks
steps.instruction: Pan-toss bite-sized chicken pieces with bhuna masala, ginger-garlic and a splash of oil for 5 mins until tender and spiced.

steps.title: Make Egg-Crusted Paratha
steps.instruction: Pour 2 whisked eggs onto a sizzling tawa. Immediately press the paratha on top of the liquid egg. Cook for 1 min until egg adheres and turns golden, then flip.

steps.title: Fill & Roll
steps.instruction: Egg side up, add the juicy bhuna chicken, crunchy sliced onions, chopped green chilies, chaat masala and fresh lemon juice. Roll tightly and enjoy restaurant quality street food!

chefTip: Pressing the paratha onto the runny egg while the egg is still liquid locks the egg directly into the paratha layers.
kitIncludes: Fresh Tender Boneless Chicken Breast Fillet
